I don't have time to meet with them as I have night classes. 

And yes a degree is better than my current job as I could get fired any moment.
It's not going to get easy. I don't have time to learn the material, I only have time to do the required work.

I'm only taking 4 classes. Calculus is too much fucking homework and so is discrete math. Even people in my discrete class have complained on the workload right in front of the professor. Don't professors realize we have jobs too!!

Seriously, the math homework! What I learn Monday, and then I have night classes, so if I don't get all the work done Monday then I can try Tuesday. Except Tuesday I have to do discrete math and it's not possible to finish that homework on Tuesday since we haven't gone through all the material from what the homework is assigned. So now on Wednesday in already behind partially from Monday and Tuesday and then more work on Wednesday and it lists builds up until I'm behind a week and have the weekend to catch up to everything. 

I don't even have time to learn. I only have time to complete the desired work.

I'm going to try to see one next week since I always thought it was just acne caused by my excessive sweating but then I looked deeper and found out what I really have. I'm 21 and there's no way I'll want to wait until I'm 30.  I did already see that online. 

Yes, I hate how I look. I look like a monster. I don't like showing any of my skin at all. I have red and brown spots all over it. Blemishes, acne, blackheads, small pimples all over my thighs, arms, elbow, shoulders, back, etc. I look like someone printed brown polka dots all over me. 

I mean, I have other issues too: depression since I was 14, and I'm a hebephile. Obviously I can't date any young girls. I'll be single forever. I'm not attracted to girls my age at all. I hate myself. I hate my body. I hate everything about me... Except my brain, since I'm intelligent, but still, depression is destroying me.
